sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut the beef into 1 inch squares and cook for 30 seconds in hard boiling water then remove.
Place the meat in a deep pot, add hot water to about 2 inches above the top of the meat. Add the scallion, anise seed, ginger, cover and let simmer for over 2 hours.
In the wok, heat 1/4 cup oil and stir fry the garlic. Add the peppercorn, hot bean paste, soy sauce, wine, and salt and cook the mix for a short time.
Add the sugar and the seasoning mixture to the beef soup and cover and let simmer for 1 more hour.
Prepare a serving bowl by placing 1 TBS chopped scallion in a bowl, add beef and some of the beef soup, add cooked noodles and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Make fish stock by bringing 10 cups of water to a boil and then add the dried fish. Simmer for 15 minutes and then remove the fish from the stock.

Add the miso to the soup stock and blend well. Then add the bean curd and heat until the bean curd is thoroughly cooked. Next add the katsubushi and scallion. Cook gently for a short time and then serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Place all A ingredients in a cooking pot. Add soup stock to A ingredients and when they reach boil with heat add the rest of the ingredients.
When soup is done remove it to a serving bowl. Garnish or compliment with chopped scallion and finely grated red pepper.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Chop the chicken until it has the texture of paste. Add it to mixture A and stir well.
Bring mixture B to a boil, add the chicken paste mixture and stir well. Add mixture C.
As the soup thickens, add the egg whites and stir well.
Serve in a bowl with the ham sprinkled over the top of individual servings.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Bring soup stock to a boil.

Marinate pork for 10 minutes. When broth is boiling, add meat and stir. Add the shredded vegetables (except the scallion) and stir again. Taste and add 1 tsp salt if needed. Add mustard pickle and scallion and dash of pepper. Season with 1/2 tsp sesame oil with chili and serve.

sections.heading: Won-Ton Filling
items: 1 cup fresh shrimp, water chestnut or fresh Chinese cabbage
Mix the above ingredients together in a bowl.
Place 1-1/2 tsp filling onto a won-ton skin and crimp the edge.
Set aside and cover with a damp cloth.

sections.heading: Soup Base
items: a few drops of sesame oil
a dash of MSG if desired

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Bring the chicken broth to a boil, add the black mushrooms and when it reaches boil again, cover it and let it simmer for at least 15 minutes.
Add salt to taste and the bok-choy and when it reaches boil again add the won-ton, scallion, and sesame oil. Allow to cook about 1 minute before removing wonton soup to serving bowl.

sections.heading: To Boil Won-Ton
items: Boil the won-ton in 4 quarts of boiling water for 3-5 minutes until the won-ton floats to the top then remove to the soup base or serve as is.

sections.heading: To Deep Fry the Won-Ton
items: Deep fry the won-ton in 375° oil until golden brown then drain them and serve hot.

sections.heading: Mixture A
items: 2 firm tomatoes cut into 1 inch cubes
1/2 cup black mushroom soaked and cut into 1 inch cubes

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Use 2 TBS hot oil to stir fry the scallion and pork until cooked.
Add mixture A and stir together.
Add mixture B and bring the soup to a boil. Thicken it with mixture C, then add the egg.
Mix well heat for a minute and then serve hot.
